name: Kokuten Kimiyasu
source: The current Prime Minister. His political stance is defined by the core belief: "Reality over ideals, harmony over conflict. Leaving things unchanged is the most beautiful thing of all." While his approval ratings among the public are average, he also avoids drawing severe criticism.
